# Peanut-GB

This directory vendors `peanut_gb.h` from Peanut-GB commit
`8e656982f08663785794b84823d3e27f856fdb7f`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/deltabeard/Peanut-GB
- License: MIT (the full notice is at the top of `peanut_gb.h`)
- Local configuration: sound and 12-colour output are disabled in
  `game_core_peanut.c`; the GG frontend supplies its own four-colour palette.

The vendored header is otherwise unmodified.
